title: Sharp positivity orders for reduction maps on perfect-tensor codes
abstract: We classify positivity of tensor products of reduction maps after restriction to perfect-tensor codes. For encodings from AME(4,d), the restricted Choi matrix splits into an isotropic code-output block and a completely positive complement. This gives the exact rank-constrained minimum for every parameter between zero and one. For every AME(6,d), an operator bound obtained from five incident-error stars proves an exact simple least Choi eigenvalue and a monotone quintic complete-positivity threshold. At the half parameter, its complementary output block is also completely positive, giving an exact positivity-order classification. Uniformly in the code dimension, the encoded three- and five-copy maps are respectively 8-positive and 32-positive. Exact code-projector witnesses show that these orders cannot be increased to 9 and 33. The entire column support must lie in the code; the opposite support is free. The results do not imply positivity of unrestricted physical tensor powers or allow tensorization of merely k-positive maps. We separate a classical low-rank PPT explanation of qutrit entanglement breaking from an explicit Weyl measure-and-prepare realization.
